recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic night scene featuring a central figure standing in the middle of a dark city street, leaning on a vertical guitar case. The background is a glowing urban skyline with neon signs and street lights creating a deep perspective towards a vanishing point.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored by a vertical guitar case silhouette
Converging road lines leading to the subject
Contrast between dark asphalt and vibrant neon city lights
Top-right typographic weight balancing the left-side neon sign
coreInvariants: Nighttime color palette with warm highlights
Slab-serif typography in the upper right quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure centered horizontally, occupying the middle third of the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark silhouette of the guitar case resting on the road surface.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the road lines from the bottom corners to the central figure, then move upward to the city skyline and right to the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of dark asphalt in the foreground and dark sky in the upper left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (asphalt and night sky)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm yellow and white (city lights and road markings)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crimson red and neon pink (text and building signage)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between point-light sources and deep shadows; mid-range saturation in neon elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single family with color contrast for hierarchy

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif aesthetic and blocky terminals.
Provides a similar geometric slab-serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a night photograph of a man leaning on a guitar case in the middle of a city street. Use a low-angle shot with converging road lines. The background should feature a blurred city skyline with a prominent neon sign on a building to the left. Lighting should be cinematic with warm bokeh.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of right-aligned text in a heavy slab-serif font to the top right corner. The top line should be white and the bottom line should be a muted crimson red.

verificationChecks: Are the road lines converging toward the subject?
Is the text in the top right corner slab-serif?
Is the lighting consistent with a night urban environment?

adjustableVariables: Color of the secondary text line
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic light reflection on the asphalt
Ensure the guitar case silhouette is distinct
Verify the slab-serif font weight is sufficiently heavy
Confirm the right-alignment of the text block
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject + vanishing point road + urban night bokeh + top-right slab-serif typography.
